content: AeroSpace (MIT, Swift, ~23.6k stars, beta): i3-like tree tiling (tiles/accordion, normalization), emulated workspaces by hiding windows in screen corner, no SIP, only private API _AXUIElementGetWindow, text config, CLI-first, no GUI/animations/borders by design. Top complaints (GitHub issues+discussions by comments): focus/workspace switch freezes due to AX blocking (#131), native tabs treated as windows (#68), ghost/dead windows, Sequoia/Tahoe breakages, floating windows disappearing between workspaces, apps randomly moving workspaces, sticky floating windows request, ultrawide max-width request, scrolling layout request, Mission Control shows hidden windows tiny.
